verdict.rationale: Letta documents scheduled tasks that automate prompts to an agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific future time. Cloud agents run on their own computers, so they keep working with the user's laptop closed, and the docs describe combining schedules with Slack to create always-on digital coworkers. Headless mode adds non-interactive runs for scripts and CI/CD. Missing for 10: detailed schedule configuration docs (schedule syntax, run history, failure handling or monitoring), independent hands-on corroboration of scheduled background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Scheduled tasks allow you to automate prompts to your agent on a recurring schedule or at a specific time in the future.
Combining agents with Slack and schedules allows you to create always-on digital coworkers.
Agents can still be messaged even if your laptop is closed, since they have their own computer to run on.
Headless mode allows you to run Letta Code non-interactively, making it easy to integrate into scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or compose with other UNIX tools.
